upstream.description: MCP server for OpenRouter — chat with 300+ LLMs (Claude, Gemini, GPT), analyze images / audio / video, generate images / speech / music / video (Veo 3.1, Sora, Seedance, Wan) from Claude Desktop, Cursor, Kiro, VS Code.

classification.analysis: A production-grade MCP server (TypeScript, published on npm/PyPI/Docker/the official MCP Registry) that connects Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, and other MCP clients to OpenRouter's unified API for 300+ LLMs, exposing chat, vision, audio, and video analysis/generation tools (Veo, Sora, Seedance, Wan) in one install. It includes hardening like SSRF guards, path sandboxes, structured errors, and 650+ automated tests, making it suitable for real deployments rather than a demo. Aimed at developers who want a single multimodal MCP integration instead of separate servers per modality.

use_cases.title: Give a coding agent access to 300+ LLMs via one MCP server
Generate or analyze images, audio, and video from an AI agent
Add vision/OCR tool calls to Claude Desktop or Cursor
